🏥 Co-morbidities / Risk Factors
Pregnancy
Diabetes mellitus / Hypertension
Renal / Liver / Cardiac impairment
Infant (<1 yr) / Elderly / Morbid obesity
On anticoagulants / NSAIDs / steroids
⚠️ Warning Signs (WHO 2009)
Abdominal pain / tenderness
Persistent vomiting (≥3 episodes/day)
Clinical fluid accumulation (ascites / pleural effusion)
Mucosal bleed (gum, epistaxis, haematuria, vaginal)
Lethargy / restlessness / altered consciousness
Liver enlargement > 2 cm
Rising HCT with rapid platelet fall
🔴 Severe Dengue Features (any = Group C)
Dengue shock — SBP <90 mmHg or pulse pressure <20 mmHg
Severe bleeding (haematemesis, melaena, large haematoma)
Severe organ impairment (liver, CNS, heart, kidneys)
